rust.reason: Agent Exchange contains no Cargo workspace or Rust production source.

nextjs.reason: Agent Exchange is an AWS Lambda Node.js service and has no Next.js application.

deploymentPolicy: Use AWS Lambda and GitHub Actions according to the publishers' documented deployment workflows. MCP is the contract and verification source.

providers.mcpGap: The available publisher-operated MagicBlock MCP in this session exposes SPL balance reads only; it does not document or verify PrivatePAY checkout, settlement, or deployment operations. Use the publisher's official payments documentation and pinned provider source for those operations.

implementationProfiles.agentExchange: Node.js 24 Lambda with the official JavaScript SDK and @solana/web3.js; no local Solana program is embedded.
implementationProfiles.wallet: @solana/kit and @solana/web3.js client integration; the wallet signs provider-prepared transactions locally.
implementationProfiles.x402Product: PrivatePAY and PDAO Wallet provide the customer-facing x402 product and API. MagicBlock supplies the exact-magicblock private SPL settlement scheme.
implementationProfiles.providerProgram: The official ephemeral-spl-token source uses native Rust and Pinocchio. It is referenced as the settlement implementation, not copied or forked into this service.
implementationProfiles.anchor: Anchor 1.0.2 is the current MagicBlock quickstart profile. Anchor 0.32.1 is a separate compatibility profile and must not be mixed into the same workspace.

privateEphemeralRollups.note: The quickstart versions are recommendations and other versions may work. The Lambda service uses the project-wide Node 24 runtime.

providers.mcpGap: No publisher-operated Robinhood Chain MCP server is configured. Mainnet reads are limited to verified JSON-RPC chain identity and read-only EVM evidence; swap quotes and market snapshots remain unsupported.
No publisher-operated MongoDB MCP server is configured in this project.
